operator_result_before_fix.exception: NoReverseMatch for cash-account-detail with an empty foreign-key value

cause: The database-free S04 presentation fixture exposes a cash-account label, not cash_account_id; its entity has pk but no entity_id on the movement DTO.
change: Render cash-account labels without a link when the foreign-key ID is unavailable. Build counterparty links from the related object pk, with a plain-text fallback. Real ORM rows retain their scoped links.
